The '''Rift Skyrail''' (or simply, '''Skyrail''') was the name for an elevated [[Monorail/Legends|monorail]] [[Train/Legends|train]] system used as a form of mass transit on [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]]. It was named after the [[Teyr Rift]], a massive canyon around which the Skyrail is built. The train connected a number of stops around the canyon, including [[Pyre Folas]] and [[Turos Noth]], but did not travel into the more rural areas farther away. Tourists would often ride simply for the spectacular views as the Skyrail hugged and sometimes crossed portions of the Rift.
